name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After § 44 – Am 58
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 44a. Reiterates its condemnation of the practice of surrogacy, a global phenomenon that exposes women worldwide to exploitation and human trafficking, while targeting financially and socially vulnerable women in particular; highlights its severe impact on women, women’s rights, and women’s health, and underlines its cross-border implications;
